description: One query that loads N parent rows followed by one extra query for each parent when its lazy association is touched.
A JPQL clause that loads an association in the same SQL statement as its owner, with parents de-duplicated by Hibernate.
A named list of attributes to load, applied to a repository method with @EntityGraph instead of writing a join fetch.
Lazy loading that initializes many associations per query with an IN list, enabled by @BatchSize or default_batch_fetch_size.
The error thrown when a lazy association is touched after its persistence context closed, which Open Session in View used to hide.
The Spring Boot default, controlled by spring.jpa.open-in-view, that keeps the persistence context open during the whole web request.
A test that reads Hibernate statistics and fails when a use case runs more SQL statements than expected.
